rationale: Class 2 row-level review. The raw schedule rows show the two flagged numeric values in rows where the same percentage is disclosed as PIK interest rate and no benchmark-plus spread is present for those cells. The defect is not scale; it is extraction into basis_spread from a fixed/all-PIK rate cell.
